description: Stage-1 proposal only. Create one mandatory table input and one table output. Existing omission preserves ports; supplied boundary is complete, never a partial patch. Navigation needs separately approved workflow support.

boundary.description: Complete supported 1-to-1 boundary. Required for a new node; editing a connected boundary must preserve GUIDs and refuse destructive changes before mutation.

input.description: External input 0, mirrored as output 0 of the inner InputNode. Required source is bound by top-level inputs, never a cross-workflow link.

kind.description: Only a native table socket in this slice; variables and trees are rejected.

name.description: Explicit technical port name; ASCII identifier, unique among input ports. Automatic and unnamed ports are outside this slice.

label.description: Literal display label of the input; independent of its technical name.

requirement.description: Source must be connected; optional inputs are deferred.

output.description: External output 0, mirrored as input 0 of the inner OutputNode. An inner local link supplies the data.

kind.description: Native table output only; read external output 0 after executing the parent.

name.description: Explicit technical port name, unique among output ports; input and output namespaces are separate.

label.description: Literal output display label, retained on the inner mirrored port.
